description: GRADED mutant catalog for the 11.4 pricing feature. It mutates the teacher-only reference implementation rather than :core, because :core holds only the DiscountRule data types and data has no behaviour to break. A property derived from a learner's spec is LOAD-BEARING exactly when it kills at least one of these; a property that kills none pins nothing, however true it happens to be.

mutants.what: Keeps a rounded-down remainder instead of subtracting a rounded-down discount.
mutants.hint: a price where the percentage is not exact: 95 at 10% is 86, not 85

mutants.what: Rounds the discount up, so the rounding favours the customer.
mutants.hint: any price where the percentage is not exact

mutants.what: Multiplies in Int, so a large price overflows.

mutants.find: if (price >= rule.threshold) reduce(price, discount = rule.amount) else price
mutants.replace: if (price > rule.threshold) reduce(price, discount = rule.amount) else price
mutants.hint: a duck priced exactly at the threshold

mutants.find: if (price >= rule.threshold) reduce(price, discount = rule.amount) else price
mutants.replace: if (duck.price >= rule.threshold) reduce(price, discount = rule.amount) else price
mutants.what: The bonus tests the shelf price rather than the price it is applied to, so an earlier discount can no longer push a duck under the threshold.
mutants.hint: a percentage rule before the bonus that drops the price under the threshold

mutants.find: private fun reduce(price: Int, discount: Int): Int = (price - discount).coerceIn(0, price)
mutants.replace: private fun reduce(price: Int, discount: Int): Int = price - discount
mutants.what: A discount larger than the price drives it negative.
mutants.hint: an amount bigger than the duck's price

mutants.what: BestOf offers the first option rather than the best one.
mutants.hint: two options where the second is the better deal

mutants.find: if (rule.condition.admits(duck)) apply(duck, rule.rule, price) else price
mutants.what: OnlyIf applies its rule to every duck.
